veh.noExactText: We hold exact fitment only for Mercedes Sprinter and KAMAZ/MAZ so far. For every other vehicle, measure the part you are replacing — these hoses are specified by dimension, so this finds the right one reliably.
veh.howtoText: Measure across the inside of the hose end, not the outside. If the two ends differ, enter the larger one — reducers are listed by both.
